reviews: Security and privacy review of cache contents and redaction guarantees
Validation correctness review of dependency coverage, invalidation, and fail-toward-run behavior

findings.summary: Cache entries store only validator name, SHA-256 key, pass/fail boolean, error count, and timestamps — no file contents, secrets, credentials, or provider data can enter by construction. Mechanically enforced by validate-speed-validation-cache.cjs allowlist and secret-pattern scan.

All nine fail-toward-run paths verified: empty inputs (coverage none), missing inputs (coverage partial), unreadable source/lib (null key), corrupt entry (readEntry null), wrong schema version (readEntry null), key mismatch (null), expiry (null), validator not in input-map (always runs), dirty tree on suite path (falls through). No path converts unknown coverage into a cache hit.

Module list sync between validate-all.cjs and cached-runner.cjs is mechanically enforced by the validate-speed-validation-cache validator, which extracts and compares both MODULES arrays element by element.

Cache deletion safety confirmed: clear() removes .projectops/validation-cache/ and every cache miss falls through to running the real validator. validate-all.cjs is unmodified and remains the authoritative uncached runner.

All timing targets met: suite cache check 44-116ms (target ≤2000ms), full cached 141-validator run 12868ms (target ≤60000ms), full uncached baseline 753s unchanged. Environment: win32 x64, Node v24.14.1, i5-13420H 12-core, 16GB.

validate-no-secrets passed at this exact HEAD (0889574) as shown in the prior session's evidence (validation-cache-0889574bd1c3-eeb46bc4). Independent re-execution was not approved in this session; the evidence from the same committed bytes stands.
